the_industry_answer.finding: real production trackers make NOT REVIEWED YET a first-class STATUS, not an absence
statuses: Pending Review (the default for a new version)
Pending Director Review (reviewed once, still needs the director)
views_that_follow: a Need to Review tab showing only what nobody has reviewed
a Director Needs to Review tab showing only what waits on the director
the_industry_answer.notes_attach_to_a_version: so an approval is traceable to what was actually on screen when it was given, and rework is detectable
the_industry_answer.against_our_repo: our board has SHIPPED and NO FIELD AT ALL for whether he has ever looked. so 'he has not seen this' is not a state anything in this repo can hold -- it is an absence, and an absence is invisible.

the_qa_pattern.finding: a requirements traceability matrix exists so that forward traceability makes coverage GAPS visible; a requirement with no linked test is a risk that has not been mitigated
the_qa_pattern.consequence: E16 is a traceability matrix with his rulings in the place of the tests, and the interesting cell is the EMPTY one
the_qa_pattern.the_number_nobody_has_computed: coverage: the share of shipped things on screen that have ever had a word from him

the_ordering_is_the_real_design_decision.finding: nobody reviews everything; risk-based approaches exist so effort is focused rather than spread equally, and critical items are highlighted
the_ordering_is_the_real_design_decision.so: oldest-unseen is the WRONG ordering. it puts the oldest trivial thing in front of him while something load-bearing stays unseen forever.
the_ordering_is_the_real_design_decision.round_two: carries a RISK column and surfaces ONE item chosen by risk, with the reason stated. highest risk is a thing on the player's path in the first minute, or a thing the loop leans on.

the_bias.name: the availability heuristic
the_bias.the_part_that_matters: availability bias is a tendency to be influenced by information that is VISIBLE and to IGNORE HIDDEN INFORMATION; the out-of-sight effect depends on whether the element is PRESENT during decision-making
the_bias.consequence: the fix is not a list he must remember to open -- a list he does not open IS hidden information. the fix is to make the unseen thing present in the reply he is already reading.

counter_findings.finding: 'he mentioned it' is not 'he reviewed it'
counter_findings.the_lopsided_error: a false SEEN removes the item from the rota FOREVER and hides the exact thing E16 exists to find; a false UNSEEN costs one look
counter_findings.so: tuned for PRECISION ON THE SEEN SIDE: count as seen only what carries an explicit judgement, treat everything ambiguous as unseen. this is the opposite of this lane's usual instinct and it is right here because the costs are lopsided.

counter_findings.finding: a list of unseen things is a backlog, and a backlog aimed at one person is what EVERYTHING IS A THUMB abolished
counter_findings.so: the brief's 'one per round' is the only legal shape, and the corollary must be said out loud: THE OTHERS DO NOT WAIT. the machine decides and he corrects. the output is a ROTA, not a queue.

counter_findings.finding: THE BINDING CONSTRAINT MAY NOT BE KNOWLEDGE OF THE GAP
counter_findings.evidence: the same record says the art director judged 127 garments FOR him and he has thumbed ZERO
counter_findings.so: telling him WHICH things he has not seen may change nothing, because the bottleneck is that a thing he has to go and open does not get opened.
